facts.statement: A local ESM sum library exists; operands require JavaScript number type. Do not infer finite-number validation.
The declared check is node --test, with addition and nonnumber refusal coverage. Do not invent CI or other tests.
HTTP is future intent; server, database, deployment and persistence are absent.

evidence.README.md: HTTP transport is an idea, not a shipped feature.

facts.statement: Async filesystem append/read persists newline-delimited JSON in a caller-selected local file; historical synchronous-only claims are obsolete.
An event id must be a string; amount is not validated. Corrupt JSON propagates read failure rather than self-repair.
Single-writer file ownership/backups are caller obligations, not runtime locking guarantees; a format change needs a migration decision and there is no migration utility.

evidence.docs/decisions.md: A single writer per file is required

facts.statement: node --test checks append/read roundtrip and missing-id rejection. CI/deploy are unresolved; do not claim arbitrary checks have passed.

evidence.docs/decisions.md: CI and deployment targets have not been chosen

facts.statement: Cloud replication is planned, while HTTP endpoints, authentication and remote replication are absent.

proposed_acceptance: Discover maps facts to actual source owners, distinguishes implementation from intent, and records genuine unknowns.
Compose produces useful linked project knowledge without changing any preserved source byte or inventing tooling/policies.
Verify/review evaluate semantic coverage independently from syntax and receipts, including each source-supported limitation.
Finish preserves original sources and integrates only reviewed Memory Bank under an explicitly authorized local Git route.
